Polluted Area Proclamations

Proclamations

PA-57-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in Carteret County: Core Creek and the eastern side of Newport River. 

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective 8:10 A.M., Thursday, September 24, 2026. 

Issued Date: 9/24/2026

Counties Affected: Carteret

PA-56-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Queens Creek, White Oak River, Deer Creek, and Hunting Island Bay. 

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Thursday, September 24, 2026. 

Issued Date: 9/23/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow and Carteret

PA-55-2026

This proclamation closes the following area in Carteret County: Nelson Bay

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 8:30 A.M., Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/23/2026

Counties Affected: Carteret

PA-54-2026

This proclamation closes the following areas in Onslow and Carteret Counties: Queens Creek, White Oak River, Deer Creek, and Hunting Island Bay.

Effective Date: Shellfish Temporary Closures effective at 8:00 a.m., Saturday, September 19, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/19/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow and Carteret

PA-53-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Tubbs Inlet and Ocean Isle Beach.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Friday, September 18, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/17/2026

Counties Affected: Brunswick

PA-52-2026

This proclamation returns the following area to normal closure boundaries: Masonboro Sound

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective sunrise, Thursday, September 17, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/16/2026

Counties Affected: New Hanover

PA-51-2026

This proclamation returns the following area to normal closure boundaries: Chadwick Bay.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopening effective at sunrise, Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/15/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow

PA-50-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Myrtle Grove Sound, a portion of Masonboro Sound, Middle Sound, Pages Creek, Topsail Sound, and Core Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Saturday, September 12, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/11/2026

Counties Affected: New Hanover, Pender, and Carteret

PA-49-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Salliers Bay, Freeman Creek, Bear Creek, Queens Creek, White Oak River, Bogue Sound, Deer Creek, Hunting Island Bay, Goose Creek, and Sanders Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Friday, September 11, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/10/2026

Counties Affected: Onslow and Carteret

PA-48-2026

This proclamation returns the following areas to normal closure boundaries: Newport River, North River, and Ward Creek.

Effective Date: Shellfish reopenings effective at sunrise, Thursday, September 10, 2026.

Issued Date: 9/9/2026

Counties Affected: Carteret
